ideas.pitch: A robust local simulation and benchmarking framework for developing and testing algorithmic agents against adversarial Warden conditions.
ideas.problem_statement: Participants will develop algorithm-driven agents that compete against one another in a shared, evolving simulation challenged by an adversarial system known as The Warden.
ideas.title: WardenGuard Arena Framework
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core final round mechanic of DEADLOCK '26 by giving other teams a testing harness while proving elite multi-agent execution.

ideas.pitch: An automated strategy-generation and code-mutation engine for competitive programmers to rapidly adapt agent logic during fast-paced rounds.
ideas.problem_statement: Participants will develop algorithm-driven agents that compete against one another in a shared, evolving simulation. Alongside competing agents, an adversarial system known as The Warden will challenge their strategies.
ideas.title: StrategySynthesizer AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the specific pressure-cooker time constraints of AGENT ARENA with a deterministic risk-gated execution loop.

ideas.pitch: A reinforcement learning agent designed for game-theory simulations that dynamically shifts heuristics when faced with adversarial Warden injections.
ideas.problem_statement: Alongside competing agents, an adversarial system known as The Warden will challenge their strategies, forcing them to adapt, optimize, and make decisions under pressure.
ideas.title: Adaptive Nash Equilibrium Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages hard algorithmic reinforcement learning to out-maneuver static opponent heuristics in the final arena.

ideas.pitch: A rapid prototyping compiler wrapper and test-case generator for mastering time-limited competitive programming qualifiers.
ideas.problem_statement: A competitive programming qualifier testing logical reasoning, algorithmic thinking, and problem-solving skills. Participants will solve coding challenges within a fixed time limit.
ideas.title: CodeSprint Automated Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a demonstrable, hard-engineering solution to streamline algorithmic problem solving under strict time constraints.

ideas.pitch: An adversarial testing framework that simulates multi-agent trade-offs and attacks agent strategies with unexpected game-state mutations.
ideas.problem_statement: Participants will develop algorithm-driven agents that compete against one another in a shared, evolving simulation. Alongside competing agents, an adversarial system known as The Warden will challenge their strategies.
ideas.title: Multi-Agent Warden Falsification Sandbox
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates complex multi-agent orchestration and rigorous adversarial thesis falsification under live simulation pressure.
